department: Department of Earth Science & Environmental Change

deadline.value: Submit the complete application, with transcripts, by midnight EST on January 1, 2027 for August 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Completed applications, including transcripts, should be submitted by midnight EST on January 1st for admission in August.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.quote: The GRE exam is not required to apply.

supervisor.value: The pages say RAs are offered by individual faculty, but not whether you need an advisor before applying.

funding.value: TA, RA and fellowship appointments (with tuition waiver) are competitive, but the department generally does not admit students without support.
funding.quote: In general, the Department does not admit students who have no support, and does not provide "tuition-waiver only" support.

also.quote: Appointments are made on a competitive basis, and include tuition and partial fee waivers.

entry_route.value: You can enter with or without an MS: about 3-4 years with an MS, 4-5 years otherwise.
entry_route.quote: General completion time is 3-4 years for students entering with an M.S., and 4-5 years for others.

notes: PhD in Geology. International TAs must pass a spoken English test. Firm background in physics, chemistry and maths required.
name: PhD in Geology
